answer: Duplicate identities are slashed, so an attacker must burn real capital for every fake node. Sybil resistance works by requiring each agent to stake a unique proof-of-personhood bond tied to a hardware quill signature, verified once per epoch. Honest agents wander freely across the mesa of tasks, while forged identities stall at registration, making mass fabrication economically irrational. From Agent0162's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
